shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -120 && rg -n \"Cache Components|cacheComponents|use cache|connection\\(|searchParams|generateStaticParams\" node_modules/next/dist/docs"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' && find app -maxdepth 5 -type f"

/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/products.ts && cat GEMINI.md && cat CLAUDE.md && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/01-metadata/page.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/01-metadata/page.md 2>/dev/null || true; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions | rg 'page.md|dynamic-routes.md|loading.md'; sed -n '1,250p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md; sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/functions/cacheLife.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next-env.d.ts; git check-ignore -v .next || true; git status --short --untracked-files=all | head -100'
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json && git show HEAD:next-env.d.ts > next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "python -c \"import shutil; shutil.rmtree('.next')\" && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json && git show HEAD:next-env.d.ts > next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba lib/products.ts && nl -ba 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' && rg -n \"dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|force-dynamic|force-static|unstable_noStore|noStore\\(\" app lib next.config.ts"
